description: This file defines the Cache class within the OFBiz framework, providing cache management functionalities for entity data, including methods for adding, retrieving, removing, and clearing cached entities and their lists.

classes.name: Cache
classes.description: Provides cache management for entity data, including methods for caching, retrieving, and invalidating cached entities and entity lists.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes cache entries for a given entity or entity name.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves cached entities or entity lists based on primary key or conditions.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores entities or entity lists into the cache.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes specific cached entities or lists based on conditions and entity identifiers.
